meta.purpose: internal consistency pins, not Flutter parity
meta.note: Settle-frame byte locks under the signed state-transition renderer. The original 60 pins use six non-default states; the selection, input and feedback batches add eight states per component. No Flutter oracle, font file, or 2%/12% pixel threshold is used. loading/success/error are business states (NO_FLUTTER_EQUIVALENT); see COMPONENT_STATE_PROPOSAL.md.
